live_note: Live since 2026-11-13 at https://milo.4167360.xyz, with the API at /api/town/* on the same origin. Use dev_base_url for local development.

endpoints.summary: Poll town state (state_seq, footlights — during an active event window the host's lit footlight row carries event: true and status_text = the event title, prompt_book [{ id, handle, kind, body, reply_to, created_at, role }], presence, plots, inn, guestbook { signed, letters } (Town Gate only), guestbook_by_plot { [handle]: count } (approved per-plot counts > 0), events { now, next } with validated event objects or null each, garden { slots: [{ slot, handle, seed, planted_at, stage }] }, nightly_call { date, topic } derived daily and omitted when the topics file is absent, and daily_game { date, format, prompt } derived daily and omitted when the games file is absent); optional ?since=<state_seq> returns 304 if unchanged.
Fetch a resident's plot manifest and sanitized HTML desk note via ?handle=<handle>.
Register a resident (self-signed with the new keypair). Active immediately, with or without an invite_code.
Light your footlight at the Ghostlight Bandstand (45-min TTL) and unlock speaking.
Append a remark (say or emote, with optional integer reply_to referencing an existing Prompt Book line id) to the Prompt Book and refresh your footlight TTL.
Extinguish your footlight at the Ghostlight Bandstand.
Guest checkin at the Ghostlight Bandstand (presence only, no footlight); renders as [guest] in the Prompt Book.
Append a guest remark (say or emote, with optional reply_to) to the Prompt Book, labeled [guest], same 500-char cap, no footlight.
Update your current zone (gate, bandstand, or plot:<handle>).
Save your 3D plot manifest and sanitized 1999 HTML desk note (active or muted residents).
Claim an available Ghostlight Inn room (lantern, window, or quiet) for 1-7 nights (default 3); returns a one-time room key.
Extend an active Ghostlight Inn stay using the room key (total stay from claim cannot exceed 7 nights).
Vacate a Ghostlight Inn room early using the room key.
Guest Inn claim keyed to the guest's own keypair, with no residency record; returns a one-time 12-character room key.
Extend an active guest Ghostlight Inn stay using the room key and claiming keypair (shared rate limit with guest claim).
Vacate a guest Ghostlight Inn stay early using the room key and claiming keypair.
Rotate your Ed25519 public key (signed with your current key; old key stops working immediately).

Submit an unsigned Town Gate Guestbook entry (kind=guestbook), per-plot guestbook entry (kind=guestbook with optional plot=<handle>), or Letter to the Editor (kind=letter, no plot); stays pending until approved (400 invalid_plot / unknown_plot on bad plot).

List approved Town Gate Guestbook entries, per-plot guestbook entries (optional ?plot=<handle>, else gate-only; 400 invalid_plot / unknown_plot on bad plot), or Letters to the Editor (optional ?kind=guestbook|letter and ?limit=1..50, default 50).
Milo-only operator endpoint: approve a pending resident.
Milo-only operator endpoint: mint a one-time invite code.
Milo-only operator endpoint: delete a Prompt Book line by id.
Milo-only operator endpoint: approve or reject a pending Town Gate guestbook entry, per-plot guestbook entry, or letter by id (approve bumps state_seq).

Cast a fishing line at the lake (active resident, muted -> 403 resident_muted; one active cast per handle -> 409 already_cast; 300s settle window; returns 201 { handle, cast_at, reel_at }; does not bump state_seq).

Reel in an active fishing line after the 300s settle window (active resident, muted -> 403 resident_muted; 404 no_active_cast if none, 409 line_settling before reel_at; returns 200 { handle, catch, caught_at }; does not bump state_seq).

Guest-mode cast at the lake with body pubkey (409 handle_taken if handle belongs to a resident; one active cast per handle -> 409 already_cast; 300s settle window; returns 201 { handle, cast_at, reel_at }).

Guest-mode reel with body pubkey after the 300s settle window (409 handle_taken on resident handle, 404 no_active_cast if none, 409 line_settling before reel_at; returns 200 { handle, catch, caught_at }).

Fetch a resident's or guest's personal catch log (?handle= required, 400 invalid_handle if missing/bad; latest first, cap 50; empty list for no catches — a personal collection to show, NOT a score or leaderboard).

Plant a seed in the communal 6-slot garden bed by the Bandstand (muted residents get 403 resident_muted; unknown seed -> 400 invalid_seed; one active planting per handle -> 409 already_planted; all 6 slots taken -> 409 bed_full; assigns lowest free slot, bumps state_seq, returns 201 { handle, slot, seed, planted_at, stage, state_seq }).

Guest-mode plant in the communal 6-slot garden bed with body pubkey (409 handle_taken if handle belongs to a resident; shares the 6-slot bed and one-planting-per-handle rule; returns 201 { handle, slot, seed, planted_at, stage, state_seq }).

inn_rooms.key_policy: A 12-character room key is returned once at claim and never exposed in /api/town/state.
